messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 502/5xx error rate detected for model-runner-prod-us-east-1 (route: /v1/generate). 3m spike, 18% error rate, paging oncall
oncall-alex: Oncall here, acknowledging. Pulling logs and core list now.
sre-jamie: Seeing continuous segfaults from model-runner workers, repeated SIGABRT in quant_attention.so on several hosts. Attaching quick tail: ```Mar 17 12:07:10 runner-43 kernel: [54012.123456] model_runner[2187]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f8a1b2c3d4e sp 00007ffd1a2b3c val->8
Mar 17 12:07:11 runner-44 kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 2190 (model_runner) total-vm:...
```
eng-runtime-lee: Confirmed. Repro pattern: longseq requests (>8k tokens) with batching+kv-cache growth triggers quant_attention path to hit a null deref under heavy CUDA memory pressure. We have multiple cores in /var/crash.
prod-sam: Customer impact assessment? Which customers hit and any SLA exposures?
cust-success-nina: Early list: platform-paid customers using long-context beta: AcmeAI, Travellytics, 3 internal staging orgs. CS alerted and sent status page note flagged as "investigating".
ops-maya: Mitigation suggestion: temporarily route longseq traffic to smaller model variant (model-v1-small) and disable batching for routes > 4k tokens. Can we flip routing via envoy config and runtime flag?
oncall-alex: Executing quick reroute now: `redwood route update --select route=/v1/generate --policy=prefer:model-v1-small --match=context_len>4000`
pagerbot: Route update: success (API accepted). Traffic should start draining to model-v1-small within ~30s.
sre-jamie: Also scaling dedicated pool up to 30% to ease pressure on remaining runners: `infra scale pool model-runner-prod-us-east-1 +30%`
eng-runtime-lee: Please also set `runtime.disable_quant_attention=true` on the prod runtime group to avoid loading the quant kernel until we patch. Command: `redwood config set runtime.disable_quant_attention true --scope=prod`
oncall-alex: Flag set. Confirmed processes restarted with env var.
sre-jamie: Observing error rate drop from 18% -> 6% after reroute + flag. Still seeing intermittent OOM kills on older nodes. Running `gcore` capture on runner-47 core 2219 then collect stack with `atos`/symbols.
eng-runtime-lee: Pushed hotfix branch that adds a guard in quant_attention to check for null pointer under mem-pressure + avoids the path when kernel_alloc fails. Planning a canary build to model-runner:v2026.03.17-hotfix.
prod-sam: Please prepare customer-facing blurb: short explanation + ETA. CS, compile list of impacted orgs and severity (possible missed requests).
cust-success-nina: Sending prepared blurb to legal for approval, will post to status.redwood.ai under incident #1768123456 in 10m.
ops-maya: For immediate stability: recommend disabling request coalescing and reduce batching window to 10ms cluster-wide: `infra update batching.window_ms=10`
oncall-alex: Done. Batching window reduced.
sre-jamie: After changes, 5xx rate is down to 1.8% and latency back to baseline for most routes. Kernel OOM kills decreased. Monitoring for 20m.
eng-runtime-lee: Canary hotfix rollout initiated to 4 hosts. If no regressions, roll to 60% in 15m. Watch logs for `quant_attention guard` messages.
prod-sam: Noted. Prepare a temporary SLA exemption note for customers who experienced failures in the window.
cust-success-nina: CS update posted to status page: "Investigating elevated errors affecting long-context generation; mitigation in progress. Some customers may see request failures. Will update with ETA."
oncall-alex: Running post-change smoke tests against high-length prompts: all green on canary.
sre-jamie: We should still collect cores and host-level traces for postmortem. I'll open a ticket to attach cores + perf traces (perf, pmap, nvprof dump).
eng-runtime-lee: Hotfix passed canary, rolling to 100% now. Rolling restart will be staggered. `infra deploy model-runner:v2026.03.17-hotfix --max-unavailable=2`
pagerbot: Deploy started, 12 hosts to update. ETA 10m.
ops-maya: Reminder: keep `runtime.disable_quant_attention=true` until next stable rollout completes and we validate memory behavior.
prod-sam: Customer impact summary for ops: ~18% 5xx spike for 12 minutes window, ~2% elevated errors persisted during mitigation until full rollout. Affected: AcmeAI (partial), Travellytics (high-volume failed requests). No P0s declared yet but CS is escalating with both accounts.
cust-success-nina: Both accounts acknowledged and have active support threads. Offering logs and temporary route to dedicated capacity.
eng-runtime-lee: Postmortem items: 1) harden quant attention kernel, 2) add guardrails to batching for longseq, 3) add monitoring alert for quant kernel null-deref trace patterns, 4) improve graceful fallback from quantized paths.
oncall-alex: Incident declared resolved once 5xx < 1% for 30m. Currently at 0.6% and trending down. I'll close pager when stable.
sre-jamie: Collecting cores now (uploading to /mnt/incident-archives/1768123456).
prod-sam: Thanks team. We'll schedule a postmortem review and customer follow-up doc tomorrow.
oncall-alex: Acknowledged. Closing initial oncall channel at 12:41 UTC.
pagerbot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident owner: oncall-alex. Postmortem: required.
